Type: compact metal-base writing desk
Use: working at a desk, laptop work; home office, bedroom, small apartment
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: wood-look box top in weathered oak finish, black powder-coated steel frame, black bar pull
Colors: light greige oak, matte black

Feel: clean, urban, calm
Goes with: grey or white walls, black accents, light wood; modern or industrial home offices

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Avery Industrial Home Office Writing Desk with Metal Base, 40"W, Weathered Gray Oak Finish
product.description: Industrial style meets contemporary functionality in this sturdy, streamlined desk. This versatile piece makes a home office or workplace style statement while also standing up to daily use. A single slim drawer offers handy storage without spoiling the elegantly sparse lines of the desk. 40"W x 18"D x 30"H Durable MDF wood with gray-washed-oak-finished hardwood veneer and an antique bronze-finished metal base A wide top offers ample workspace for writers, artists, or busy professionals. The single drawer slides easily. The clean lines of this desk speak to its industrial-chic roots. The distressed gray finish of the top pairs perfectly with the antiqued metal base. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the wood grain. Free returns for 30 days; 1-year warranty.
